 Important General Election Information for Voters
 
 

 
 Black Hawk County
 
 
 Posted on October 13, 2026 | Last Updated on October 13, 2026
 
 
 


 

 

 
 

 
The Black Hawk County Election Office will offer in-person absentee voting beginning Wednesday, October 14, through Monday, November 2, in the Basement Conference Room at the Black Hawk County Courthouse, 316 E. 5th Street, Waterloo. Regular voting hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. The Election Office will also be open for extended voting hours on Saturday, October 31, from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
Absentee ballots will be available beginning Wednesday, October 14, 2026, for all Black Hawk County voters for the General Election on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. Absentee ballots requested by mail will also begin being mailed to voters on Wednesday, October 14, 2026.
Satellite Voting Locations and Hours
Black Hawk County voters may also vote at satellite locations throughout the county. 
Wednesday, October 14, and Thursday, October 15
• UNI Maucker Union, 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
Friday, October 16
• UNI Maucker Union, 11:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m.
Saturday, October 17
• Cedar Valley SportsPlex, 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
Wednesday, October 21
• Diamond Event Center, 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
Saturday, October 24
• Cedar Heights Community Presbyterian Church, 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
• Good Shepherd Lutheran Church, 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
Wednesday, October 28
• Friendship Village, 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
Thursday, October 29
• First Baptist Church, 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
Absentee Ballots by Mail
The deadline to request an absentee ballot by mail is 5:00 p.m. on Monday, October 19, 2026. Requests must be received by the Election Office by the deadline; postmarks do not count.
Official absentee ballot request forms are available on the Black Hawk County Elections website. Completed forms may be mailed or delivered to:
Black Hawk County Election Office
316 E. 5th Street
Waterloo, IA 50703
Prepaid return postage is included for absentee ballots returned by mail. Voted absentee ballots must be received by the Election Office no later than 8:00 p.m. on Election Day to be counted.
Voter Registration Deadline
The deadline to pre-register to vote is 5:00 p.m. on Monday, October 19, 2026.
Eligible voters may still register after the preregistration deadline, subject to Iowa's election-day registration requirements. Voters registering after the deadline must provide proof of identity and residence. A valid Iowa driver's license with the voter's current address is the most common form of identification used for this purpose.
Voters who have requested a mailed absentee ballot should follow the ballot instructions carefully. Absentee ballots cannot be returned at polling places unless the voter surrenders and voids the absentee ballot and votes in person instead.


For polling locations, sample ballots, voter registration information, and election deadlines, visit the Black Hawk County Elections Website, call (319) 833-3007, or email election@blackhawkcounty.iowa.gov
